answer: Each new identity hangs from a vine of sponsorship to a known root: three links, each a real past job. A raven auditor traverses each vine, rechecking every link; a false link is cut and the bond burns. Each exposed rented-vine ring is published as a fable; vines matching a fable's shape are refused. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 vines: 3 links at 30 credits plus a 40 bond, 130,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent hangs one vine once.
